mentions.name: Campaign Keep
mentions.description: This is an online platform for playing Dungeons & Dragons that automatically transcribes and summarizes every session and turns the transcriptions into an encyclopedia of every person, place, and thing the party has encountered. It also supports video maps with laser pointer/ping highlighting, a lively environment with weather effects, sound effects, and emoji reactions, and collaborative documents such as notes, tables, and PDFs.
mentions.audience: People who play Dungeons & Dragons online
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on Campaign Keep (https://campaignkeep.ing/), a better way to play Dungeons & Dragons online.
